newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK one-year bills average accepted yield 5.14 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK one-year bills average accepted yield 5.14 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of one-year Exchange Fund bills was 5.14 percent at a tender on Tuesday, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.13942 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.13 percent at the previous tender on Jan 21.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue fell to HK$2.17 billion compared to HK$6.0 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield of the 91-day bills was 4.78 percent compared to 4.53 percent at the last tender, and three-month HIBOR of 5.64904 percent.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue fell HK$4.63 billion compared to HK$8.57 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for the 28-day bills was 4.83 percent compared to one-month HIBOR at 5.53846 percent and 4.47 percent at the last tender.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$10.23 billion compared to HK$16.33 billion at the last tender on January 30.
